opening.argument: The video presents BitClub Network as a way to earn passive Bitcoin-related income while requiring viewers to pay to participate. It states, "To Join BitClub, you pay a one-time membership of $99," then promotes "one share that pays you for 1,000 days of mining." The offer also includes referral compensation: "You can get paid for referring new Bitcoin members." Together, these terms describe a paid mining opportunity built around promised daily returns and recruitment-based compensation, establishing the basis for the charge.
